text:
maya: Quick UX check — spotted inconsistent CTAs and terminology between the top-level console docs panel and the inline help drawer. Example: the panel shows "Open docs" while the drawer CTA says "View guide".
jonathan: yeah I saw that too. Which routes?
lina: Model settings -> Integrations -> Docs panel. Also shows up on Workspace > Routes.
maya: Also accessibility nit: the drawer's CTA is a button visually but has aria-label="open-link" which isn't descriptive. Should be "Open model docs".
ash: oof. That aria mismatch could fail audits. Where do we track the copy change? :pencil2: 
maya: Don't want to create a full spec yet — quick decision: unify the verb to "Open docs" and update aria to "Open model documentation". Thoughts?
jonathan: +1 for "Open docs". Short and consistent with navbar. Also keyboard hint in the drawer shows `?` in one place and `Shift/` in another — unify to `?`.
lina: I'll add a small PR for the copy and aria changes. Can someone confirm the canonical term? Is it "docs" or "documentation" across Console?
maya: We used "docs" in the top nav and API pages. Use "docs" for CTAs. Use "documentation" in longer sentences.
docs-bot: New doc updated: "In-product help panel — terminology guide" (link: https://go.redwood/docs/help-terminology)
ash: perfect. After Lina's PR, can we sweep accessibility labels and keyboard hints across the entire helpflow? Could be a quick grep: `rg "aria-label" src | rg help`.
lina: Will do. I'll drop the PR link here when ready.
maya: Thanks — if you need a second on copy I can pair. :thumbsup: 
jonathan: small follow-up: cross-links in the panel point to /docs/guide while inline links go to /guides. We should redirect or normalize.
ash: agree. I'll file a routing redirect task in backlog if Lina's PR goes in today.
lina: PR: 1881234599 — copy + aria + keyboard hint fixes. pinging for review.
maya: Reviewing now.
